# Cuddles AI

> Cuddles AI is a plant expert first and an AI-powered cannabis budtender second — it helps with houseplants, herbs, vegetables and indigenous species as well as cannabis. Free personalized strain recommendations, strain scanner, journal, community reviews, and same-day delivery in South Africa via Tripple444.

Cuddles AI helps consumers care for any plant and find the right cannabis strain through a chat interface and helps dispensaries sell smarter through embeddable AI budtending and POS integrations (Dutchie, Flowhub, Cova, Sweed). General cannabis education only — not medical advice.

## Pages

- [Home](/): AI cannabis budtender chat, strain finder, delivery.
- [Shop](/shop): Cannabis product catalog (vapes, oils, flower) with same-day delivery.
- [Catalog](/catalog): Browse the full Tripple444 product catalog.
- [Strains directory](/strains): All cannabis strains with terpene, THC/CBD, and effect data.
- [Plant care directory](/plants): Care guides for houseplants, herbs, vegetables, succulents and South African indigenous plants.
- [Featured strains](/strains/featured): 10 weekly hand-picked strains.
- [Strain reviews](/reviews): Community reviews and ratings.
- [Strain journal](/journal): Track sessions, dosage, and effects.
- [Strain scanner](/scanner): Identify strains from a photo using AI.
- [Tolerance break coach](/t-break): Personalized tolerance reset plan.
- [Seedling monitor](/grow): Cultivation tracker with care logs.
- [Premium](/premium): Cuddles Premium (R99/mo) features.
- [Blog](/blog): Cannabis education, science, and African market updates.
